title: 📋 FRIDAY 21 AUGUST 2026 — LEGS DAY WORKOUT SHEET
content:
📋 FRIDAY 21 AUGUST 2026 — LEGS DAY WORKOUT SHEET

[HEADER]
Session: Legs & Calves (Quad, Hamstrings, Calves)
Time Cap: 45 Mins Max | Salt Ayre Gym
Hydration: 1.5L water + 1 electrolyte tab pre-gym
Breathing: Continuous exhale on push/flex (RPE 7-8 max, NO Valsalva breath-holding)
Upper Body Rule: Keep chest/shoulders completely relaxed on Leg Extensions (NO hard bracing into handles)
Cardio Rule: ZERO bike/cardio on Legs Day (Preserve lower body glycogen & prevent extreme nausea)

[EXERCISES]

1. LEG PRESS MACHINE (Quads / Glutes)
   * Safety: Feet shoulder-width mid-plate. Smooth controlled descent, do NOT bounce at bottom.
   - Feeder Set 1: 63kg x 10 (Joint prep)
   - Feeder Set 2: 97kg x 8 (Warm-up)
   - Working Set 1: 120kg x 10
   - Working Set 2: 143kg x 10 [Last: 143kg x 10] ➜ OVERLOAD TARGET: 143kg x 11-12 reps OR 143kg + 1 adder pin x 8-10 reps
   - Drop Sets: 109kg x 8 -> 86kg x 10
   * Plan B Swap: Dumbbell Goblet Squats (25kg DB)

2. SEATED / LYING LEG CURLS (Hamstrings)
   * Safety: Lock pad above ankles. Full hamstring squeeze without arching lower back.
   - Feeder Set: 50kg x 10
   - Working Set 1: 70kg x 10
   - Working Set 2: 84kg x 10 [Last: 84kg x 10] ➜ OVERLOAD TARGET: 84kg x 11-12 reps OR 84kg + 1 adder pin x 8 reps
   - Drop Set: 50kg x 10
   * Plan B Swap: Lying Single-Leg DB Hamstring Curls

3. LEG EXTENSIONS (Quad Isolation)
   * Safety: Pull butt into seat cushion (do NOT grip handles to tense chest/shoulders).
   - Feeder Set: 36kg x 10
   - Working Set 1: 43kg x 10
   - Working Set 2: 63kg x 12 [Last: 63kg x 12] ➜ OVERLOAD TARGET: 63kg x 13-14 reps OR 63kg + 1 adder pin x 10 reps
   - Drop Set: 36kg x 10
   * Plan B Swap: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squats (10kg DBs)

4. DUMBBELL CALF RAISES (Calf Gastrocnemius / Soleus)
   * Safety: Full stretch at bottom on edge/flat, hold 1-sec peak contraction on toes.
   - Working Set 1: 27.5kg x 15 [Last: 27.5kg x 15] ➜ OVERLOAD TARGET: 27.5kg x 16-18 reps
   - Working Set 2: 27.5kg x 18 [Last: 27.5kg x 18] ➜ OVERLOAD TARGET: 27.5kg x 19-20 reps OR 30kg x 12-15 reps
   - Working Set 3: 25.0kg x 15 (Burnout set)
   * Plan B Swap: Standing Machine / Bodyweight Deficit Calf Raises
